title: サイレンススズカ登場！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To prepare for her debut race, Silence Suzuka partakes in scrimmages at the academy, where she astounds onlookers with her runaway style.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, she remains unmoved by the attention, and is only focused on seeing the scenery from the lead of a race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Here begins the story of Silence Suzuka, a racer who loves running more than anyone, as she seeks to break the limits of speed itself.
